mapper.sql: b.id, b.booking_no AS bookingNo, b.course_id AS courseId, b.user_id AS userId, b.craftsman_id AS craftsmanId, b.contact_name AS contactName, b.contact_phone AS contactPhone, b.quota AS quota, b.remark AS remark, b.status AS status, b.checkin_code AS checkinCode, b.checkin_time AS checkinTime, b.audit_time AS auditTime, b.reject_reason AS rejectReason, b.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, b.cancel_by AS cancelBy, b.cancel_time AS cancelTime, b.create_time AS createTime, c.title AS courseTitle, c.cover AS courseCover, c.address AS courseAddress, c.start_time AS courseStartTime, c.end_time AS courseEndTime, c.price AS coursePrice, c.booking_deadline AS courseBookingDeadline, c.cancel_deadline AS courseCancelDeadline, cr.real_name AS craftsmanName, cr.craft_type AS craftType, u.nickname AS buyerName
FROM booking b LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = b.course_id LEFT JOIN craftsman cr ON cr.id = b.craftsman_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = b.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(c.start_time) >= 6 AND HOUR(c.start_time) < 12 THEN 'morning' WHEN HOUR(c.start_time) >= 12 AND HOUR(c.start_time) < 18 THEN 'afternoon' WHEN HOUR(c.start_time) >= 18 THEN 'evening' ELSE 'night' END AS slot, COUNT(*) AS bookingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status IN (1, 4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passedCount, SUM(b.quota) AS quotaSum FROM booking b JOIN course c ON c.id = b.course_id WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND c.start_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY slot

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status IN (4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attend, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 2) AS endedCourseCount FROM booking b JOIN course c ON c.id = b.course_id WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 2 AND b.status IN (1, 4, 5)

SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.title AS courseTitle, cr.real_name AS craftsmanName, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status IN (4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attend, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absent FROM booking b JOIN course c ON c.id = b.course_id LEFT JOIN craftsman cr ON cr.id = c.craftsman_id WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 2 AND b.status IN (1, 4, 5) GROUP BY c.id, c.title, cr.real_name HAVING absent > 0 ORDER BY absent DESC, total DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{topN}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS submitted, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checkedIn, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitAudit, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled FROM booking WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.title AS courseTitle, c.cover AS courseCover, cr.real_name AS craftsmanName, c.start_time AS startTime, c.status AS status, c.total_quota AS totalQuota, c.remain_quota AS remainQuota, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.status IN (0, 1, 4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bookingCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.status IN (0, 1, 4, 5) THEN b.quota ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bookingPeople FROM course c LEFT JOIN booking b ON b.course_id = c.id AND b.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN craftsman cr ON cr.id = c.craftsman_id WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.title, c.cover, cr.real_name, c.start_time, c.status, c.total_quota, c.remain_quota ORDER BY bookingPeople DESC, bookingCount DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{topN}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDay, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passedCnt, SUM(quota) AS quotaSum FROM booking WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{start} GROUP BY statDay ORDER BY statDay
